protectedSourceBoundaries.committedSourceProves: Compile metadata selects nested, external or unresolved property-selected source; committed local bytes do not establish its compilation closure.
protectedSourceBoundaries.recommendation: Keep refusal. Supply an approved root-contained committed source closure or redesign the upstream qualification source selection.

protectedSourceBoundaries.committedSourceProves: Inherited import alternatives escape the owning committed root; local source does not prove the external file or its classification.
protectedSourceBoundaries.recommendation: Keep refusal. The owning maintainer should provide root-contained committed metadata, or propose a separately approved generic cross-root import contract. Do not inspect nested or sibling worktrees.

protectedSourceBoundaries.committedSourceProves: Committed script resolves an exact target under a nested gitlink, which is deliberately unopened.
protectedSourceBoundaries.recommendation: Keep refusal. Move ownership/verification to the owning root or obtain an explicit source-boundary design decision; do not initialize the nested repository.

protectedSourceBoundaries.committedSourceProves: The project is generated in a runtime temporary directory; the committed source does not provide the actual project/blob closure.
protectedSourceBoundaries.recommendation: Keep refusal. The owning maintainer should check in an inspectable fixture or propose an explicit generic generated-source contract; a historical fixture label grants no exemption.

scannerLimitations.committedSourceProves: Target selection depends on runtime inputs, external commands or dynamic manifest/control-flow evaluation outside the committed literal subset.
scannerLimitations.recommendation: Implement a narrowly specified static committed-manifest selector where complete provenance can be proved; otherwise request upstream explicit committed target declarations. Execute no inspected helper.

scannerLimitations.committedSourceProves: An executable heredoc expansion remains outside bounded static resolution in a source that also contains publication commands.
scannerLimitations.recommendation: Keep refusal until a generic lexical expansion model proves every executed substitution or upstream source uses literal quoted heredocs.

scannerLimitations.committedSourceProves: Source uses PowerShell variables, cmdlets, property access, functions or collection iteration outside the supported shell resolver.
scannerLimitations.recommendation: Add a separately tested bounded PowerShell model only if it preserves assignment order, scope, alias/builtin overrides and provider/ref state writes; otherwise retain this coverage error.

upstreamSourceDefectAssessment: No active upstream source defect is established solely by these coverage errors. External-layout alternatives, generated fixtures, caller-owned action targets and partial test data require contextual owning-maintainer assessment.
